0.text: Why hello deary! Such a brave young thing, you are! You remind me of myself when I was your age.

1.text: Sorry, forgive an old woman her dreaming, it’s been so long since my skin was supple and my bones didn't creak with every waking moment.

2.text: How can I help you today love?

0.text: I’m investigating the figure on the moors.

And such a frightful figure it is! I’ve seen it myself, two… no, three times I believe. At dusk, when the sun is setting behind the Lamavora Belt, there it is… a tall, pale, ghastly thing, clothed in tattered robes, standing on the hills watching over us.

1.text: I thought it to be a ghost or some kind of long forgotten phantom. Not once did I suspect that it might harm one of us.

2.text: ...Poor Barnaby… He was a good lad, full of vibrancy and life. I can’t say for certain this mysterious figure is responsible, but it seems mighty coincidental if it’s not.
